h1: Custom Baseball Vests for Teams & Events
metaDescription: Shop custom baseball vests in bulk for your team or event. Perfect for dugouts, coaches, and fans. Fast turnaround from Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Custom baseball vests give your team a polished, unified look without the weight of a full jacket. Whether you're outfitting a little league dugout, a college coaching staff, or a corporate softball team, a vest layers easily over jerseys or long sleeves. The Men's Mercer+Mettle™ Puffy Vest offers a quilted finish that holds up to frequent wear and washing. Add your team name, logo, or sponsor artwork with screen printing or embroidery for a professional finish that keeps everyone looking sharp from warm-ups to post-game.
heroAltText: Custom baseball vests for teams and events featuring embroidered logos on quilted puffy vests
